mentions.name: Affiche
mentions.description: Affiche is a cross-platform GUI system that separates an application's UI semantics from the toolkit that renders it, so the same application can be presented with native Win32, Cocoa/AppKit, Qt6, GTK3, GTK4, Swing, or a web browser. The UI can run locally or be rendered remotely by a client without the application being rewritten for that environment. Work also includes a declarative layout format and a visual designer; the project is private and under development.
mentions.problem: Maintaining applications that need to survive changes in GUI toolkits, operating systems, deployment models, or client environments.
mentions.audience: Maintainers and developers of applications that need to survive changes in GUI toolkits, operating systems, deployment models, or client environments.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I've been working on a cross-platform GUI system called Affiche.

The basic idea is to separate an application's UI semantics from the toolkit that actually renders it.
mentions.author: neverartful
